title: Brown has met someone who saw a UFO in a hangar

tellings.quote: Have you met anybody who you think has seen a UFO in a in a hangar? Like >> Oh, in a hanger. >> Yeah. >> Yes.

plain: The claim is that a real UFO is being kept in a hangar, and that someone has seen it there. Michels asked Matthew Brown, a former Pentagon official who has come forward as a whistleblower, whether he had met anybody who he thinks has seen a UFO in a hangar. Brown answered simply, "Yes," but gave no names or details.
